research_question: Does exact BTC perpetual taker order imbalance in seconds 0-9 of quarter-hour openings, followed by either immediate 10-59 second confirmation or a short reversal inside an aligned public state, predict cost-positive four-to-eight-hour returns strongly enough to justify four-asset expansion?

implementation_reason.v23_data_failure: Binance USD-M one-second kline archives do not exist for the required history.
implementation_reason.replacement: Stream official daily aggTrades archives and retain only each quarter-hour opening minute.

data.visibility: seconds 0-9 define state; seconds 10-59 define an independent event-minute transition; entry is the final trade of that minute

evaluation.same_event_arbitration: short-reversal delivery first, then larger normalized imbalance times route quality
evaluation.overlap_policy: no new selected event while the fixed route horizon is active
evaluation.screen_scope: BTC-only exact-data mechanism screen; a pass requires immediate four-asset expansion before Nautilus promotion

advance_gate.final_integrated_system_frequency_requir: at least one independent completed trade per evaluation calendar day across the four-asset global account

decision_contract.advance: A fixed route positive in all four splits and passing the BTC screen expands unchanged to BTC, ETH, SOL and XRP.
decision_contract.reject: Do not tune the exact order-imbalance, event-minute transition or public-state thresholds after seeing these results.
